scope: Read-only source review; no production edits, inference, dataset text disclosure, or measured RPS claims.

ner.inference: Torch FP32 default; auto CUDA if available else CPU; word-aligned windows512/stride128; first-subword argmax, no probability threshold.
ner.decoder: Whitespace words retokenized on brackets/quotes/comma/colon/semicolon/!? and boundary dots; offsets retained. Consecutive same native type is merged even across B-tags. Punctuation bridge only for non-name/non-address native labels.
ner.window_caveat: A single oversized word over510 subwords becomes O rather than being chunked; center ownership avoids duplicate overlapping windows.
ner.all_native_labels_kept: All21 mapped labels are requested, not merely the four NER_ONLY_ENTITIES; those four indicate capabilities unavailable without model.

rules_and_merging.architecture: Presidio with built-in recognizers cleared; spaCy NER disabled but other NLP pipeline components remain. Custom numeric classifiers and regex recognizers provide16 types.
rules_and_merging.numeric_classification: Candidate patterns run in priority order with span deduplication. All classifiers run; highest score wins and later classifier wins an exact score tie. Same-digit overlapping candidates are deduplicated.
rules_and_merging.rules: INN10/12 and SNILS use control digits; card Luhn plus context (16-digit competes with OMS), OMS requires Luhn+context; passport/driver licence use length+nearby cue disambiguation, not checksum. Account combines20digits+BIK, context fallback; invalid-checksum account can still emit at0.60.
rules_and_merging.boundary_policy: data_spans strips service words and some punctuation after classifying whole candidate; it can split series and number into separate entities. This differs from gold that includes contextual words.
rules_and_merging.model_gate: NER email must satisfy local@domain shape with tight @, TLD, or40-character preceding email cue.
rules_and_merging.resolution: First keep every rule and remove any NER span overlapping any rule. Then classifier type priorities, registered pair priorities, custom handlers, longer same-type overlap, and greedy score/length/start overlap resolution. No clipping/union preserves a discarded NER tail.
rules_and_merging.allowlist: The engine filters allowed types after conflict resolution. A disallowed rule may already have removed an overlapping allowed NER span.

lossless_hackathon_compatibility.normalization: normalize_text always replaces Unicode spaces/dashes, removes invisible characters, collapses spaces and converts Russian number words; optional English-number rewrite follows. Offsets and returned normalized_text refer to this changed string. No complete original-input offset map exists for these steps.
lossless_hackathon_compatibility.transliteration: Adds a mapped Cyrillic pass plus original pass; its SpanMap maps changed words as whole source words, but source is already normalized. Keep only a candidate shadow view mapped back to original for SEIF.
lossless_hackathon_compatibility.base64: Each detected encoded blob incurs another rules+NER pass; any decoded PII maps to full original blob. Budgets32blobs/20000decodedchars reject overflow instead of silently skipping. This is broader masking with extra inference cost.
lossless_hackathon_compatibility.pseudonymization: Stores nominative/fuzzy-merged person identity and grammatically inflects restoration. Stateless HTTP returns mapping to caller; no TTL or correlation-id vault. That is useful for an LLM proxy but is not exact original-byte restoration or SEIF API compatibility.

published_metric_protocol.paper_scorer: tests/quality/paper_score.py; JSON prediction dumps and experiment manifest are not tracked.
published_metric_protocol.mapping: Native21 name components fold into PERSON, six address components into ADDRESS. EMAIL_ADDRESS/PHONE_NUMBER become EMAIL/PHONE; remaining12 model families retain identity.
published_metric_protocol.strict: One-to-one greedy matching by exact type/start/end; gold spans never trim or merge.
published_metric_protocol.soft: One-to-one same type and any character overlap; different from old quality gate many-gold-to-one-prediction overlap.
published_metric_protocol.pipeline_mode: Predictions only: merge PERSON/ADDRESS neighbors with gap<=12 matching punctuation/whitespace or address connectives. Gold remains unmerged.
published_metric_protocol.scopes: Shared scopes filter both gold and predictions; remaining predictions overlapping excluded gold are also ignored. Thus scoped precision is not full-output precision.
published_metric_protocol.published_pinned_docs: docs/quality.md currently reports87.1 strict/92.9 typed-soft for own2841-row benchmark/14families; common6 table90.3/95.0. User-cited83.6/88.9 must be reconciled separately, not asserted reproduced.

deployment_and_licensing.runtime: Python3.11 CPU Docker default; single Uvicorn process, serialized inference semaphore1,30s queue wait→503;64texts×100000chars per request. No queue/state-store service and no TensorRT runtime.
deployment_and_licensing.reproducibility: Code supports revision pin, but default is None and Docker NER_REVISION empty. Most dependencies have lower bounds without exact lock. Image bakes weights and forces HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; library loader can download if unprepared.
deployment_and_licensing.access: Container user10001, compose binds127.0.0.1; bearer API keys optional, unset means no authentication; validation handler omits input values. SEIF authentication/vault contracts should stay intact.
deployment_and_licensing.license_observation: Repository LICENSE/NOTICE declare Apache-2.0 and separate weights Apache-2.0. Preserve attribution, LICENSE/NOTICE and modification notices if code is copied. Optional latin-gender declares GPLv3 and is excluded from default dependency/image; no need to borrow it.

confirmed_validator_caution.finding: Correspondent-account validator prefixes0+first2BIKdigits and rejects a real public Alfa bank requisites pair.
confirmed_validator_caution.verification: Executed only AST-extracted valid_account and WEIGHTS, no imports/model. Published official bank fixture returnsFalse; current prefix remainder5, alternative0+BIK[4:6] remainder0. A source-level counterexample, not a complete independent financial-standard audit.

borrowing_priorities.idea: Native structured21 candidates plus independent checksum/context evidence; nearest document cue and NER email shape checks.
borrowing_priorities.conditions: Frozen taxonomy and offset-preserving spans; retain uncertain malformed values under explicit context rather than universal checksum rejection; evaluate across all3corpora.
borrowing_priorities.rps_expectation: Light local predicates over existing candidates; no new NER pass. Measure real HTTP afterward; no guaranteed free speed.

borrowing_priorities.idea: Entity-specific boundary policy and explicit conflict diagnostics.
borrowing_priorities.conditions: Compare full protected-character coverage and per-type exact spans. Do not copy unconditional rule-wins whole-span deletion, global prediction address/name merging or late allowlist filtering.
borrowing_priorities.rps_expectation: Bounded span operations are cheap at current candidate counts; upstream nested conflict passes are O(n²), so retain SEIF candidate caps.

borrowing_priorities.idea: Optional transliteration/base64 shadow analysis with original-offset map and strict budgets.
borrowing_priorities.conditions: Separate capability, never overwrite source. No model invocation for cheap negatives; native root text must remain exactly restorable.
borrowing_priorities.rps_expectation: Potential2passes with transliteration and1extra per base64blob, plus language detection; cannot promise existing RPS.

borrowing_priorities.idea: Port useful standalone rules with source attribution and independent validation vectors.
borrowing_priorities.conditions: Do not import the whole Presidio/spaCy/morphology stack solely for numeric checking; correct/test the observed correspondent-account defect before borrowing.
borrowing_priorities.rps_expectation: Avoid additional NLP pipeline and serialized service layer; benchmark isolated rules + integrated HTTP.
